description: Generate the Escode/escrow-agent scoping-answers report (markdown) over all escrow-scoped codebases: repo list, languages, MEASURED build times + machine spec, CI/CD tooling, Terraform topology + database counts, deposit status, test-data position. Fields the platform cannot measure are marked OPERATOR INPUT REQUIRED. Optional clientTag filters to one beneficiary; store=true also persists the markdown to Storage (part of the delivery pack sent to the escrow agent) and returns its downloadUrl. store=true requires `write` scope.

clientTag.description: Limit to codebases tagged for this client.

store.description: Persist the report to Storage and return storagePath/downloadUrl.

name: anyforge_escrow_scoping_report
title: Escrow scoping report
